Substitution of Insurance Carrier

LIFE INSURANCE

ENDORSEMENT METHOD SPLIT DOLLAR PLAN

AGREEMENT

The Life Insurance Endorsement Method Split Dollar Plan Agreement between Robert B. Bantle as Insured and Tompkins Trust Company (the "Bank") dated Jan. 10, 2002 (the "Agreement) is amended to reflect the replacement of the Union Central Life Insurance Company and Security Life of Denver life insurance policies on the Insured in a tax-free exchange under I.R.C. Section 1035 with the Northwester Mutual Life Insurance Company, respectively as follows:

Insurer.

Northwester Mutual Life is substituted for Union Central and Security Life

Policy Number:

17188743 is substituted for U200001276 17188897 is substituted for 660014737

In all other respects the Agreement is hereby ratified and confirmed.

_(City, State) this.

_21

，2006.

day of

Tompkins Trust Company Ithaca, New York
